title: Pitchfork bifurcation and traveling waves for a planar ensemble of rigid filaments with repulsive interaction
summary: The so-called Filament Based Lamellipodium Model is a complex modeling framework for a very heterogeneous chemo-mechanical system of cell biology. It contains a model for Coulomb repulsion between filaments, whose effect on the stability of the system has been unclear. In this work, a strongly simplified version of the model is considered, showing a destabilizing effect of the repulsion. This instability results in a pitchfork bifurcation with an additional rotational symmetry, leading to a two-dimensional bifurcating manifold of traveling wave solutions.
